features.text: **Recurring tasks**: Set a task to repeat daily, weekly or monthly; the next one appears when you complete it.
**Search inside attachments**: Search now finds words inside attached PDF and Word files, not just card titles.
**Keyboard shortcuts**: Press ? to see every shortcut and get around your boards without the mouse.

improvements.text: **Faster sync**: Large boards sync about 2x faster (measured on a board with 2,000 cards).
**Touch-friendly drag and drop**: Long-press a card to pick it up; the board scrolls for you near the edges.
**Richer CSV export**: Your exports now include custom fields.

fixes.text: Fixed large images (over 10 MB) failing to upload without a message; you can now compress them and retry.
Fixed reminders arriving an hour early after a daylight saving time change.
Fixed the notification badge not clearing after you read your notifications.
Fixed line breaks disappearing when you paste text from Google Docs.
Fixed dates showing in US format for people using English (UK).

security.text: **Password changes sign out other devices**: Changing your password now signs you out everywhere else. Thanks to the external researcher who reported this.
**Expired sign-ins rejected**: Expired sign-ins are now always refused; before, some stayed valid for up to 24 hours.
